headline: 19-year-old second wife of MP Gazi Nazrul Islam found dead in Dhaka
summary: Moriah Khatun was found hanging from a ceiling fan in a flat at NAM Bhaban in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar.
details: The body of Mosa. Morium Khatun, the 19-year-old second wife of Satkhira-4 MP GM Nazrul Islam, was recovered from a flat at NAM Bhaban in Dhaka's Sher-e-Bangla Nagar.
Police arrived at the scene around 7:00 PM on Sunday, September 10, after receiving a report. They found Morium's body hanging from a ceiling fan in one of the rooms.
The Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station confirmed the event. The immediate cause of death has not yet been determined.
The circumstances surrounding her death have created mystery, and authorities are awaiting further investigation to determine the exact cause and details of the incident.
caption:

Police arrived at the scene around 7:00 PM on Sunday, September 10, after receiving a report. They found Morium's body hanging from a ceiling fan in one of the rooms.

The Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station confirmed the event. The immediate cause of death has not yet been determined.

The circumstances surrounding her death have created mystery, and authorities are awaiting further investigation to determine the exact cause and details of the incident.

headline: 13-year-old killed over an iPhone in Comilla
summary: A schoolboy was lured to a forest, beaten with a bamboo stick, and murdered by three people to steal his mother's phone.
details: Ishayat Shahriyar Opratim, a 13-year-old student of Border Guard Public School, was murdered after being lured to a forest in the Lalmai Hills area of Comilla.
Opratim had left home on Friday afternoon with his mother's iPhone to take photos with friends. He never returned, and his body was recovered from the jungle on Saturday afternoon.
Police report that the victim was beaten with a bamboo stick on the head when he resisted the attempt to snatch his phone. Three suspects, including the main mastermind, have been arrested.
The boy's body showed severe head injuries. Police recovered the stolen iPhone from the home of one of the suspects, identified as Tuhin.
Opratim's classmates, including 23 students from the seventh grade, attended his funeral, where they expressed their grief and demanded the death penalty for the killers.
The Home Minister has assured that the government will assist in a speedy trial to ensure justice for the boy.
caption:
A 13-year-old boy was murdered for an iPhone. He was lured to a forest and beaten to death with a bamboo stick.

Ishayat Shahriyar Opratim, a 13-year-old student of Border Guard Public School, was murdered after being lured to a forest in the Lalmai Hills area of Comilla.

Opratim had left home on Friday afternoon with his mother's iPhone to take photos with friends. He never returned, and his body was recovered from the jungle on Saturday afternoon.

Police report that the victim was beaten with a bamboo stick on the head when he resisted the attempt to snatch his phone. Three suspects, including the main mastermind, have been arrested.

The boy's body showed severe head injuries. Police recovered the stolen iPhone from the home of one of the suspects, identified as Tuhin.

Opratim's classmates, including 23 students from the seventh grade, attended his funeral, where they expressed their grief and demanded the death penalty for the killers.

The Home Minister has assured that the government will assist in a speedy trial to ensure justice for the boy.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV
